newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barges edge nearly $2 higher with Asia.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barges edge nearly $2 higher with Asia.

text.p: Rotterdam gas oil prices firmed nearly $2 a tonne, with gains of $1.50 on the IPE and a further 25 cents on premiums on Thursday.
"We traded 50 cents, but that was for prompt. First half May is worth a dollar," said a trader with Rotterdam refinery.
May IPE climbed $1.50 to $164.50 after a record 2.44 million barrels or around 340,000 tonnes of diesel was bought by three trading houses in Singapore.
Prices traded in Singapore were lower than recent levels at around $26 a barrel or close to $194 a tonne.
Dealers said cargoes in Europe were quiet after Russian cargo premiums edged higher on Wednesday.
Diesel remained well bid $11 a tonne above the May IPE but supply was tight due to slow Russian supplies, dealers said.
